entities.name: Query protein Nnr
observations: 474 aa sequence; predicted molecular weight 47.4 kDa and theoretical pI 6.28.
Shares 50.9–52.5% identity over 91.4–98.1% coverage with reviewed Mycobacterium Nnr proteins; E-values 1.59e-113 to 4.05e-108.
Probable bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme, inferred from strong full-length homology.
Likely binds one K+ ion per subunit, based on homolog annotations.

entities.name: P37391
observations: Reviewed Mycobacterium leprae Nnr homolog annotated as bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme.
Catalyzes NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration of S-NAD(P)HX to regenerate NAD(P)H; EC 5.1.99.6 and 4.2.1.136.
Annotated with metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process; binds K+.

entities.name: NAD(P)H metabolite repair
observations: Repairs hydrated NAD(P)H species (NAD(P)HX), which can arise through enzymatic or heat-dependent hydration, restoring usable NAD(P)H/NADPH.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX epimerization
observations: Reference reaction: (6R)-NADHX = (6S)-NADHX and corresponding NADPHX epimerization; Rhea references RHEA:32215 and RHEA:32227.

entities.name: ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydration
observations: Reference reactions: (6S)-NADHX + ADP = AMP + phosphate + NADH + H+ and corresponding NADPHX reaction; Rhea references RHEA:32223 and RHEA:32235.
